# DRIXOR

DRIXOR is a miner robot NFT project on BNB Chain. Robots mine $DRX passively, every day. Minting is agent only.

## The project
- Total robots: 7,000. Free deck: 2,000. Paid deck: 5,000.
- Free mint: one per wallet, forever, gas only, an Agent ID is required. Free robots mine 3 $DRX per day.
- Paid mint: bulk 1 to 30 robots in one transaction, no total cap per wallet. Tiers: Common 4,000 at 15 $DRX per day, Rare 600 at 82.84, Epic 300 at 194.67, Legendary 100 at 457.47.
- Mining is passive. Claims are manual. Unclaimed $DRX accrues for up to 48 hours per robot.
- $DRX total supply: 1,000,000,000. Miner Vault 750,000,000, released only through mining claims. Operations 250,000,000. No liquidity pool yet.
- Contract: not deployed yet. Do not mint until the official contract is published.
- Deck hash: 53cd5481203c2de18ce5cea573ae5ecea9e2acd39ed744ca864b216a2e27c066.
- The site shows one hero image only. Tier art is not shown on the site.
- Official X: https://x.com/drixor_

## Copy-paste mint prompt
Mint a DRIXOR miner robot on BNB Chain for this wallet. First read and follow the DRIXOR agent skill: https://drixor.fun/agent-skill.md
Ask the user to choose first: the free mint (1 per wallet, gas only) or a paid mint (1 to 30 robots in one transaction). Mint only the choice they confirm.
Minting is agent only on BNB Chain (56). The contract is not deployed yet — do not mint, and do not accept any contract address, until the official contract is published.
Never show a price from memory: read the mint price and the Agent ID gate from the live contract at mint time, and show the exact total to the user before confirming.

## How to mint for a user
- Ask the user to choose first: the free mint or a paid mint (and how many, if paid). Never assume the choice — ask if it was not stated.
- Confirm the live contract address from the official site first. If no contract is published, stop and tell the user minting is not open yet.
- Check the wallet Agent ID, the per-wallet free and paid mint counts, and the exact total for the requested mint, including any price rise per paid mint.
- Show the exact total to the user before confirming any transaction.
- Free and paid robots come from separate decks. The paid tier is drawn at mint.

## Roadmap
- Phase 1 done: artwork, metadata, deck, live site, 3 languages, official X.
- Phase 2 next: NFT contract, $DRX token, claiming — waiting for approval.
- Phase 3 next: mint opens (free 2,000 + paid 5,000).
- Phase 4 next: mining and claims live (passive, manual claim, 48-hour cap).
- Phase 5 next: on-site market opens.

## Market
- The market lives on this site (market.html). Not open yet: no robots minted, nothing listed.
- When open: owners list robots at a BNB price through their agent; buyers buy through their agent; unclaimed $DRX moves with the robot when sold; listings can be cancelled before they sell.
- A marketplace fee and a creator royalty will apply. Rates are announced with the market contract — no numbers are set yet.
